definitions.short: to force a passage , as by burglary; figuratively, with oars
definitions.full: H2864. chathar חָתַר verb dig, row (Late Hebrew id., bore (through), so Aramaic ᵑ7 חֲתַר (rare)) — Qal Perfect ׳ח Job 24:16 , חָתַרְתִּי Ezek 12:7 ; Imperfect וָאֶחְתֹּר 8:8 , יַחְתְּרוּ 12:12 ; Amos 9:2 , וַיַּחְתְּרוּ Jonah 1:13 ; Imperative חֲתָרֿ Ezek 8:8 ; 12:5 ; — 1 dig into houses, with accusative בָּתִּים Job 24:16 (of burglary); followed by בְּ into or through a wall Ezek 8:8 (twice in verse) (Co strike out on internal grounds), 12:5 , 7 , 12 ; metaphor followed by בשׁאול Amos 9:2 dig into She'ôl , i.e. as a refuge. 2 row (as digging into the water) Jonah 1:13 .
